shared_elements: schematic engraved motifs on a natural rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, outline-drawn engravings including apparently anthropomorphic or face-like forms, but that is about as generic as rock imagery gets. A shows a few large, isolated curvilinear mask/face-like designs filling each boulder face, whereas B shows a crowded narrative panel of crewed boats with stroke-figures, small human figures, animals and a large ladder/grid motif — no shared specific motif or relationship.
